'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

When searching the drawers, the chatbox message "The drawers are locked! A note is scratched on the top of the drawers: It's a guard's life." is displayed, hinting that you must obtain the key from one of the guards in [[East Ardougne]].
